{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] was the location of an '''observation post'''. On one occasion, the observation post sent out [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to stop a malfunctioning [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-Series pilot droid]] [[Unidentified RX-series pilot droid (Naboo)|unit]] that had hijacked its [[Unidentified RX-Series pilot droid owner|owner's]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The droid managed to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] before the fighters could stop it, en route to the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] where the planets [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], and [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] were located.<ref name="SGD">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
